weights.intro: How much each attribute counts towards a player's score. The scores update as you type. The FM27 role profiles are benchmarked on FM Match Lab's position study (13b).
weights.benchmark: Benchmarked FM27 role weights (FM Match Lab <link>Study 13b</link>).

profileDescriptions.fm27-cb: FM Match Lab FM27 benchmark (<link>Study 13b</link>): centre-backs.
profileDescriptions.fm27-wb: FM Match Lab FM27 benchmark (<link>Study 13b</link>): full-backs and wing-backs.
profileDescriptions.fm27-dm: FM Match Lab FM27 benchmark (<link>Study 13b</link>): defensive midfielders, also used for central midfielders.
profileDescriptions.fm27-10: FM Match Lab FM27 benchmark (<link>Study 13b</link>): attacking midfielders and wingers.
profileDescriptions.fm27-9: FM Match Lab FM27 benchmark (<link>Study 13b</link>): strikers.
profileDescriptions.fm27-gk: FM Match Lab FM27 benchmark (<link>Study 13b</link>): goalkeepers.

weights.linearNote: Linear matches how the FM27 benchmarks and “vs Age” are calibrated.
